name: Lumbia
description: A stand of sago palms. Felling a palm and washing the starch from its pith is hard work, but one palm gives a great deal of sago flour, which keeps well.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
